releaseCommitReachabilityNote: console-contract-v1.0.2 tags cfd930a, which is on backend main, unlike console-contract-v1.0 and v1.0.1 which tagged branch commits a squash merge never placed there. The field stays false regardless, because it records what this lock relies on rather than what happens to be true: the tag and its object survive because the release is immutable, not because the commit stayed reachable. Reachability must not become a check.
releaseRevisionNote: The third tag component is a release revision, not an API version.
